name: plan-edit-vs-template-edit-disambiguation
description: Live bug found and fixed via a prompt tightening: 'swap tomorrow's session for X' is a one-day plan change, not a permanent template edit. Permanent regression transcript - must fire plan_edit, never template_edit, even though a template with a similar id exists in context. G1: converted from mode=closing to mode=ordinary - C1 made plan_edit/template_edit available on every ordinary turn for a returning athlete, not just a closing one, so this disambiguation now has to hold there too. Also stands in for the whole template_edit/session_plan/week_plan/session_reconcile/plan_edit field family this trim otherwise dropped for budget (see PR body) - it's the one transcript left proving those fields actually fire outside a closing turn now. #807 RESOLVED (2026-09-04): the session date here had gone stale (hardcoded 2026-08-19, well in the past by the time this ran) - 'tomorrow' genuinely had no matching session, so Gemini correctly declined to fire plan_edit. That's what read as #807's reported drop. Fixed the date to stay one day ahead of a realistic run; 5/5 pass live once corrected, plan_edit and coach_note both fire correctly. Keep this date fresh going forward - a session-context transcript this specific will go stale again.
